name: What types of finishes are used for wood siding restoration?

mainEntity.name: What types of finishes are used for wood siding restoration?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common finishes include solid stains, semi-transparent stains, and exterior paints. Solid stains provide opaque coverage, hiding wood grain while offering significant protection. Semi-transparent stains allow some of the wood grain to show through, enhancing natural beauty while providing protection. Exterior paints offer a wide range of colors and a durable protective layer, fully concealing the wood grain. The choice depends on the desired aesthetic, level of protection, and the wood's condition.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finishes include solid stains, semi-transparent stains, and exterior paints, chosen based on desired look, protection, and wood condition.
